prompt:
Subject:
White shirt on a crowded train

Main Subject:
The main subject is a woman wearing a white shirt gripping a strap in a crowded commuter train, centered in the frame.

Character & Expression:
Small oval face, large dark brown eyes, thin eyebrows, neat nose, glossy pale peach lips. Her expression is calm, enduring the heat by looking away to the right. Dark brown hair is tied in a low bun, leaving wet thin bangs and loose strands.

Clothing & Pose:
A white sleeveless collared button shirt that becomes translucent with sweat, black high-waist skirt, black leather shoulder bag. Right arm extended straight up to grip a triangular strap, left arm lowered by her side while standing.

Background & Light:
From left to right background, passengers in white shirts filling the sides and depth, silver poles, straps, fluorescent lights inside the train. Soft white fluorescent light from above evenly illuminates the face and sweat gloss.

Composition & Camera:
3:4 vertical composition, close frontal camera at chest height capturing a half-body portrait from top of head to below waist. Person placed very large in center, occupying most of frame height. Raised arm and surrounding passengers cropped at edges, focus on profile and white shirt, background slightly blurred.

Texture & Style:
Photorealistic live-action photo. High definition skin, hair, clothing material, and surroundings; maintaining commuting colors of white, black, silver, and skin tone.

Negative:
Change strap pose; omit interior and white shirt
